facts.fact: Tubi says it entertains over 100 million monthly active users (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Tubi says entertains over 100 million monthly active users

facts.fact: Tubi says Nielsen's ratings rank it #1 fully free, fully ad-supported streaming service (vendor-reported Nielsen ranking).
facts.quote: the #1 fully free, fully ad-supported streaming service

facts.fact: Tubi says Nielsen ranks it #2 free AVOD platform in adult 18+ reach (vendor-reported Nielsen ranking).
facts.quote: the #2 free AVOD (ad-supported video on demand) platform in adult 18+ reach

facts.fact: Tubi says Nielsen ranks it #4 streamer in 18+ ad-supported reach (vendor-reported Nielsen ranking).
facts.quote: the #4 streamer in 18+ ad-supported reach

facts.fact: CNBC reported that Fox's fiscal fourth-quarter advertising revenue rose 78% to $1.92 billion, largely due to the World Cup and Tubi (third-party reporting).
facts.quote: Fox’s fiscal fourth-quarter advertising revenue rose 78% to $1.92 billion

facts.fact: CNBC reported that Fox announced a proposed $22 billion acquisition of Roku in June 2026, which is still only a proposal (third-party reporting).
facts.quote: Fox announced a proposed $22 billion acquisition of Roku in June 2026

facts.fact: Business of Apps put Tubi at 78 million active users in 2024 (third-party estimate).
facts.quote: put Tubi at 78 million active users in 2024

facts.fact: Business of Apps put Tubi revenue at $900 million in 2023 (third-party estimate).
facts.quote: $900 million in revenue in 2023

facts.fact: Tubi was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in San Francisco, part of Tubi Media Group, a division of Fox Corporation.
facts.quote: It was founded in 2014, is headquartered in San Francisco

facts.fact: Tubi ads are sold by CPM, the price per 1,000 ad impressions; the page's example is a $20 CPM meaning $20 buys 1,000 plays.
facts.quote: A $20 CPM means $20 buys your ad 1,000 plays.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page says daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000 with no subscription and no contract (vendor's own pricing).
facts.quote: daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000 with no subscription and no contract

facts.fact: Adwave says a $75/day plan over 30 active days totals $2,250, and the daily budget is all-in with no fees added on top (vendor's own example).
facts.unit: USD total for 30 active days at $75/day
facts.quote: A $75/day plan over 30 active days totals $2,250

facts.fact: Adwave says TV is included in its plans starting from the $30 daily budget floor (vendor's own statement).
facts.quote: TV is in the mix from the $30 floor

facts.fact: A TV spot usually runs 15 or 30 seconds in 16:9 aspect ratio.
facts.quote: It usually runs 15 or 30 seconds in 16:9.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page lists extra 15-second TV spot creative at $6 each.
facts.quote: Extra creative is priced separately: $6 for an extra 15-second TV spot and $12 for an extra 30-second spot, per the pricing page.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's published thresholds, streaming TV, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram channels open at a daily budget of $30.
facts.quote: streaming TV, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram from $30/day

facts.fact: According to Adwave's published thresholds, Google Search opens at a daily budget of $30.
facts.quote: Google Search from $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave sets aside each day's budget every morning and charges the advertiser the next morning only for media that ran, so undelivered media is not charged.
facts.quote: Each morning the day’s budget is set aside, and the next morning you’re charged only for what ran, so media that didn’t deliver is never charged.

facts.fact: Adwave states that card deposits add a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits do not carry that fee.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits don’t.

facts.fact: Adwave states that pausing a campaign stops future daily set-asides, and campaigns pause if the wallet cannot cover the day.
facts.quote: Pausing stops future set-asides. Campaigns pause if the wallet can’t cover the day, and auto-refill is optional.

facts.fact: Tubi describes itself as free to watch and supported entirely by advertising.
facts.quote: Tubi is free to watch and supported entirely by advertising, which is how Tubi describes itself
